summary: ansible-galaxy role setup --list shows your Travis integrations with their IDs.
questions: How do I see my Galaxy Travis integrations?
How do I find a Travis integration ID?

answer_card.title: List Travis integrations
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy role setup --list travis github_user github_repo xxx-travis-token-xxx
```
The output lists each integration's ID, source and repo.
